disorder-name.detail: First Episode Psychosis; ICD-10 criteria for psychotic disorder; patients were medication naïve or free (no current or previous antipsychotic treatment, or not taking medication at scanning with at least 6 months washout for oral medication or 6 months for depot); N=25 patients (FDOPA_01 dataset, Invicro London). Note: the FEP cohort may include diagnoses beyond schizophrenia spectrum (e.g., affective psychosis, unspecified psychosis).
disorder-name.supporting_text: "The FDOPA_01 dataset included FEP patients who were recruited if they had a diagnosis of psychotic disorder according to ICD 10 criteria"

dataset-of-origin.detail: Single imaging site (Invicro, London); study-specific dataset originally reported in Jauhar et al. 2017 (JAMA Psychiatry) [Ref 7] and Jauhar et al. 2019 (Biol Psychiatry) [Ref 47]. Scanner: Hi-Rez Biograph 6 (PET/CT).

age.detail: Patient-specific age not reported separately in Table 1. Table 1 reports combined age (patients + HC) for FDOPA_01: mean 26.25 (SD 5.18) years (N total ~86–87, comprising 25 patients + 61 controls). Min/max not reported.

sex.detail: Patient-specific sex not reported separately in Table 1. Table 1 reports combined sex (patients + HC) for FDOPA_01: 32F (36.7%) / 55M (63.21%) (N total ~87, comprising 25 patients + 61 controls; 1 subject discrepancy with expected N=86 may reflect a missing value).

disorder-name.detail: Schizophrenia; three datasets combined: FDOPA_02 (DSM-IV chronic SCZ, N=24, South Korea, first-line antipsychotic-treated), FDOPA_03 (DSM-IV chronic SCZ paranoid subtype, treatment-resistant, N=24, MRC Cyclotron Unit), FDOPA_04 (DSM-V schizophrenia or schizophreniform disorders, patient groups described as 'Mixed (FEPs + Chronic)', N=36, Invicro London); total N patients=84. The paper refers to FDOPA_04 as 'an independent dataset of patients with SCZ' in the Methods. FDOPA_04 inclusion criteria also encompass schizophreniform disorder (SZF).
disorder-name.supporting_text: "The FDOPA_02 dataset included patients with a DSM-IV diagnosis of SCZ...Patients in the FDOPA_03 dataset were also patients who met the DSM-IV criteria for SCZ, paranoid subtype...the FDOPA_04 dataset included patients who met the DSM-V criteria for SCZ or schizophreniform disorders"

dataset-of-origin.detail: Three different imaging sites across FDOPA_02–04: FDOPA_02 at Bundang Hospital (South Korea; Kim et al. 2017 [Ref 45]), FDOPA_03 at MRC Cyclotron Unit (London; Demjaha et al. 2012 [Ref 9]), FDOPA_04 at Invicro (London; Egerton et al. 2021 STRATA [Ref 46]). All are study-specific datasets not listed in the normalized dataset keyword table.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "Imaging Site: South Korea | MRC Cyclotron Unit | Invicro"

age.detail: Patient-specific age not available for FDOPA_02 and FDOPA_03 (Table 1 shows combined patients+HC age: FDOPA_02 mean 29.00 [SD 8.70] years, FDOPA_03 mean 44.52 [SD 9.97] years). For FDOPA_04 (patient-only dataset, N=36, no matched HC): mean 30.63 (SD 10.91) years — this is patient-specific. A pooled patient-only age across all three datasets cannot be reliably calculated because patient-specific data are unavailable for FDOPA_02 and FDOPA_03.

sex.detail: Patient-specific sex not available for FDOPA_02 and FDOPA_03. Table 1 reports combined (patients + HC) sex: FDOPA_02 17F (34.0%) / 33M (66.0%), N=50; FDOPA_03 21F (58.88%) / 13M (36.22%), N~34 (2 subjects with unknown sex). For FDOPA_04 (patient-only, N=36): 8F (22.22%) / 28M (77.77%) — patient-specific. A pooled patient-only sex ratio across all three datasets cannot be reliably calculated because patient-specific data are unavailable for FDOPA_02 and FDOPA_03.
